title: Call to action
description: A band asking for one thing: a heading, a line and a button or two, on the accent, a tint, the page or a picture — or the picture alone.

schema.label: Heading
schema.help: Two equals signs around words set them off in the accent colour: Homes ==by the river==.

schema.label: Button link
schema.help: A page, an address, or a file from the library to download. The address #webx-form-<slug> opens that form of the inbox in a dialog.

schema.label: Button address (old)
schema.help: What this button had before it took a link. Used only while the link above is empty: choose the link, then clear this.

schema.label: Button look
schema.help: The first button: filled with the accent as before, a thin outline in the colour of the words, or the accent darkened.

schema.label: Second button link
schema.help: A page, an address, or a file from the library to download. The address #webx-form-<slug> opens that form of the inbox in a dialog.

schema.label: Second button address (old)
schema.help: What this button had before it took a link. Used only while the link above is empty: choose the link, then clear this.

schema.label: Picture
schema.help: Across the whole band, under a shade that keeps the words readable. A picture with no words and no buttons is the picture alone. Without a picture the band is the colour of the shade.

schema.label: Picture in front
schema.help: Over the shade and never darkened: a brochure or a phone in a PNG or WebP with transparency. Beside the words, under them on a phone.

schema.label: Shade
schema.help: Dark: light words on a darkened picture. Light: dark words on a lightened one. Gradient from the side: dark behind the words, fading out across the band. Gradient from the top: the colour of the page at the top, the picture clear below. The dark scheme of the site turns them round.

schema.label: Words
schema.help: At the bottom: the words and the buttons along the bottom of the band. Beside the picture: the words on the left in the middle of the height, the picture in front on the right. At the top, centred: the words in a column at the top, the picture in front under them.

schema.label: Parallax
schema.help: The picture moves a little slower than the page as it scrolls, drawn slightly larger so its edges stay out of sight. Never for visitors who ask for less motion.

schema.label: Parallax strength
schema.help: How far behind the page the picture falls.

schema.label: Height
schema.help: By the content: as tall as the words, or as the picture when there are none. Words that need more than the screen or the proportion make the band taller.

schema.label: Without animation
schema.help: Shown at once, even where the theme brings its blocks in as the page scrolls.

schema.label: Slide over the section above
schema.help: The section above stays in place while this one comes up over it, and its words fade. The edge pictures stand over this section's top. Visitors who ask for less motion see the sections one after another.

schema.label: Edge picture
schema.help: Over the top of this section, as wide as the page: fog or clouds in a PNG or WebP with transparency, its bottom row in the colour of this section.

schema.label: Edge picture on a phone
schema.help: The same edge for a narrow screen. Without it the edge picture above is used there too.

sample.heading: Ready when you are
sample.text: One line on what happens after the click.
